v0.3.3 Attribution Rules

Priority: manual override → normalized roster → unmatched. Credit: one program gets 100%; two get 50% each; three get 33.3% each. Volunteer mix: fractional volunteer equivalents. Performance ranking: credited volunteer hours, highest to lowest, within the selected date range.
